observations: Photo 0-1 show a portable rectangular speaker/radio unit, taupe/grey color, with a carry handle, two small displays (one showing track info, one showing an equalizer-style readout), rounded control knobs and a row of buttons.

The front has a perforated speaker grille with a square button/logo in the center, text appears to read 'ON JU' or similar but is largely obscured by a watermark reading 'DEALS MASTER GLOBAL LIMITED'.

Photo 2 is a close-up of a product label reading: 'MONDO BT SPEAKER LARGE', 'Input: 5V==3A 9V==3A', 'Capacity: 6000mAh 66.0Wh', 'FCC ID:2AKFED200', 'Manufactured in China', 'Mondo by Defunc', 'Designed by a Star AB, Hornsgatan 22, Stockholm, Sweden'.
Photo 3 is a rotated duplicate angle of the same unit, powered on with the same screen readouts.

A semi-transparent watermark 'DEALS MASTER GLOBAL LIMITED' appears across photos 1-3, suggesting these are listing images from a reseller/dealer rather than fresh photos of the seller's own unit in situ.
No cable, charger, box, or accessories are shown.
No close-up of body for scratches, dents, or grille damage is provided beyond the two main angles.

claims.evidence: No audio/sound clip provided; loudness and audio quality cannot be judged from still photos.

claims.claim: Implied working condition (screen is lit, showing track info)
claims.evidence: Photo 0, 1, 3 show the display lit with track/station text, indicating it powers on, but no proof of Bluetooth pairing, sound output, or battery holding a charge over time.

claims.claim: Implied genuine Mondo by Defunc unit
claims.evidence: Label in photo 2 matches a real brand/model naming, but the watermark pattern suggests these could be stock/dealer images rather than photos of the actual unit being sold by this seller.

risks.risk: Photos may be stock/dealer listing images rather than the actual item in the seller's possession
risks.proof: A fresh photo of the unit with today's date/handwritten note, or a photo in a different setting than the watermarked ones
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown / treated with caution for misrepresentation risk

risks.risk: No proof of actual sound output or speaker quality
risks.proof: A short video/clip of the speaker playing audio at volume
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working (worst case: display-only, no audio output)

risks.risk: Battery health/capacity unknown (6000mAh rated, but age and charge-holding unverified)
risks.proof: A video showing battery percentage indicator and runtime test, or charging cycle count if available
A photo showing included cable/charger and original packaging

risks.risk: Physical condition (scratches, dents, grille damage) not fully visible
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all sides, corners, and the grille
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified, assume moderate wear

proof_requests: A short video of the speaker playing music/radio to confirm sound output and volume
A fresh, un-watermarked photo of the unit taken today (e.g., with a handwritten date or current news on a nearby phone) to confirm it's the seller's actual item
Close-up photos of all sides and the grille for cosmetic condition
Photo of included accessories (charging cable, adapter, box)
A photo of the battery indicator/charge level or a short charging demonstration
response.reason: The item is identifiable by its label (Mondo BT Speaker Large, Defunc) in photo 2, but the seller's claim of it being 'great and powerful' is unverifiable and the watermarked, possibly-stock nature of the photos plus lack of audio/accessory/condition proof means it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, accessory-less, audio-unconfirmed unit.
